title: Humans adaptively delay planning using cognitive maps: data, task materials and analysis code
description: Companion archive for Sharp & Eldar, Humans adaptively delay planning using cognitive maps (Psychological Science, manuscript PSCI-26-0102). Contains the anonymised raw trial-level data of both preregistered studies (Study 1, n = 93 retained of 101; Study 2, n = 163 retained of 251), the PsychoPy/PsychoJS task implementation and stimuli (materials), the preprocessing pipeline, every analysis script and notebook used for the results, tables and figures, fitted model parameters and posterior traces, and a README with step-by-step reproduction instructions and a reproducibility-check table. Preregistrations: Study 1 https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/QS9JA; Study 2 https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/5Y9Z6.
